## Tools
- [Niche Picker](quiz.html) — Answer 6 questions, get ranked niche suggestions with reasoning — or take the 4-question "Pick my 2027 niche" branch, scored against the Niche Atlas 2027 outlook layer.
- [Revenue Calculator](calculator.html) — Project revenue from views, niche, sponsors, and affiliates — with honest ranges.
- [90-Day Planner](planner.html) — Generate a posting schedule from your platforms and cadence. Printable.
- [Sponsor Deal Analyzer](deal-analyzer.html) — Benchmark a sponsor offer against the 2026 rate card — verdict, red-flag checklist, counter-offer worksheet.
- [The Deal Room](deal-room.html) — Manage the whole deal: track offers through signing, price usage rights, rehearse negotiations, export your memo.
- [Hiring Cost Calculator](hiring-calculator.html) — Price your first hire: monthly/annual cost and the ad revenue needed to cover it — honest math, no promises.
- [Repurposing Planner](repurpose.html) — Turn one idea into a 5-platform mission-card checklist from the Phase 3 repurposing SOP.
- [Empire Simulator](simulator.html) — Simulate 12–36 months of channel growth + revenue — 12-scenario library, A/B comparison, team hiring P&L, what-if event cards, Money Map stage transitions — a model, not a prediction.
- [API Explorer](api-explorer.html) — Browse every api/v1 endpoint and preview JSON responses live in your browser — no key, no server.
- [Hook Builder](hook-builder.html) — Type your video topic, get five filmed-ready hooks — one per Short-Form Playbook structure. Flip-through cards.
- [Idea Bank](idea-bank.html) — Capture ideas with hook-strength scores (1–5, Playbook structures), niche tags, and effort estimates — promote the best to production.
- [90-Day Content Calendar](content-calendar.html) — Deal your idea bank into a 90-day grid: week-planner dealing rules, drag/keyboard moves, sponsor slots, copy-my-calendar export.
- [Batching Planner](batching.html) — Film-day math: does your shoot capacity actually cover your cadence? Honest surplus/shortfall, consistency-beats-volume framing.
- [The Money Map](money-map.html) — Find your stage on the $0-to-company journey: 7 questions, 5 stage playbooks, your next 3 moves. Stages are focus guides, never income promises.
- [Diagnose My Video](video-doctor.html) — Pick your symptom — low CTR, the 30-second cliff, great retention but no subs — and get ranked causes with the fix from the chapter that owns it.
- [YPP 2027 Eligibility Checker](ypp-checker.html) — Enter your subs, watch hours, and Shorts views — get your verdict under the current YPP bar and the Feb-2027 bar, the gap math, and a chapter-grounded plan to close it.
- [The Outreach Center](outreach.html) — Run your sponsor pipeline outbound: track pitches in a CRM-lite, generate honest pitch emails, quote from the 2026 rate card, and flag contract red flags before you sign.
- [Cross-Post Optimizer](crosspost.html) — Move one clip to every platform without getting throttled: per-destination adaptation checklists (aspect, captions, hooks, CTAs, disclosure labels) under the Oct-1 originality rules.
- [Glossary](glossary.html)

All seventeen tools, grouped by job (Plan / Money / Content): [Tools hub](tools.html).

## API
- api/v1/index.json — self-describing manifest: every endpoint, schema URL, updated timestamp, record counts
- api/v1/chapters.json
- api/v1/niches.json — the Niche Atlas dataset v2.0.0: 20 researched niches, 2027 outlook layer (trajectory badges, breakout spotlights, platform signals, stream-fit matrix), avoid list, sources, reality check
- api/v1/glossary.json
- api/v1/calculators.json
- api/v1/skills.json
- api/v1/case-files.json
- api/v1/tools.json — every tool's programmatic input schema
- api/v1/deal-templates.json — Deal Room data: negotiation scripts, red-flag checklist, usage-rights tiers, pitch templates, contract red-flag checklist
- api/v1/content-engine.json — Content Engine data: idea formats, Playbook hook structures, dealing rules, Repurposing 2.0 map, originality guardrails, deal-slot guidance
- api/v1/schema/ — JSON Schema (draft-07) for every endpoint

## Skills
- analytics-review: Run the monthly analytics ritual — find outliers, diagnose retention, and decide what to make more of.
- content-repurposing: Turn one long-form video into a five-platform distribution package with the pillar-to-everywhere SOP.
- deal-negotiation: Evaluate a sponsorship offer against the 2026 rate card — benchmark the price, flag contract traps, and build a defensible counter-offer.
- first-hire-planner: Plan a creator's first hire end to end — bottleneck test (editor vs VA vs designer vs ops), 2026 rate ranges, coverage math via the Hiring Cost Calculator logic, the 2-week paid trial, SOP templates, and contractor-vs-employee basics. Not legal or tax advice.
- hook-writing: Write and stress-test video hooks — the first 30 seconds (long-form) or first 2 seconds (short-form) that decide everything.
- live-shopping-playbook: Plan a TikTok live selling session from the Phase 6 POD research — format, timing, and the unit economics of selling live.
- niche-validation: Validate a creator niche before committing — demand, competition, monetization, and winnability scored in one pass.
- rate-card-reader: Look up fair 2026 sponsorship price ranges for any follower tier, platform, and deliverable — straight from the site's rate-card data.
- repurposing-sprint: Execute the 5-platform pillar-to-everywhere SOP from the Phase 3 playbook — one pillar video becomes five native posts on a staggered schedule.
- shortform-hook-craft: Craft and stress-test short-form hooks using the five Short-Form Playbook structures — open loop, cold start, contrarian take, numbered promise, question-as-hook — with retention editing rules and the anti-hook checklist.
- sponsorship-pitch: Build a complete sponsor outreach system — targeting, email, pricing, and negotiation for creator brand deals.
- thumbnail-teardown: Systematically diagnose why a thumbnail underperforms and produce a concrete redesign brief.
